evidencePolicy.phoneMetadata: GPS, altitude, compass direction and elapsed walking time are not indoor dimensions or surveyed positions
evidencePolicy.originalFiles: Unmodified source video and metadata text remain in the supplied source folder. Access digits, personal locker labels and identities are not reproduced.
evidencePolicy.unreadableOperatingValues: No invented readings, setpoints or live operating state are displayed; unreadable displays remain dark or anonymous.
evidencePolicy.gitStorage: Unmodified original video/phone metadata remain local. Large original video, CAD/reference originals and generated exports are excluded from Git; source listings, provenance/hashes, evidence records and regeneration tools are retained.

observedFacts.firstFloor: Native-resolution overlook distinguishes three stainless guarded packing cubicles: one tall rectangular V-shaped twin-outlet hopper and two compact round dosers, notched machinery landings joined by a rear catwalk, and a four-hoop caged ladder. The green zone contains two distinct blue/cream articulated arms visible together, at least three alignment lanes, compact guarded case-packing forms, short transfers and a brown curved conveyor. Six open round HVAC jets and a lower cabinet, a floor fan and two wrapped corrugated bundles are context. Unverified X-ray curtains were removed; historical IDs do not establish equipment technology or OEM.
observedFacts.mezzanine: User-confirmed 1.5F naming; one entered dressing room, OP room, green observation corridor, actual internal/exterior windows and safety bars, continuous lower-hall views and connected two-flight stairs. The dressing-room threshold/approach stays on solid slab beside the stair opening. No second dressing room or gender assignment is inferred.
observedFacts.thirdFloor: The indoor footprint is reduced from 3F upward. Two-row yellow exterior windows, lower stainless wall protection, flush drains, three visible IBCs, supported overhead utility/spiral duct runs, the narrow yellow storage-door pane and the actual closed roller shutter are distinguished. Two cone hoppers have differing inlet forms including a wide white flexible coupling, visible lower flange/valve/manifold details and a shared pierced service deck. CIP includes at least two visible tank tops, bolted motor flanges, attached open manhole lids, checker plate outside deck holes and three dark display faces. Local service decks are not additional building floors.
